# Logicleap Technologies

> Logicleap Technologies Private Limited is a software development company based in Pune, Maharashtra, India. The company builds websites, web applications, mobile-ready software, game systems, AI workflow tools, automation, APIs, integrations, and cloud-backed products for clients in India and abroad.

## Key Facts

- Legal name: Logicleap Technologies Private Limited
- CIN: U58203PN2023PTC220263
- Founded: 2023
- Location: Pune, Maharashtra, India
- Primary business email: contact@logicleaptechnologies.com
- Support and privacy email: support@logicleaptechnologies.com
- Website: https://logicleaptechnologies.com/

## Services

- Website and web application development
- Mobile-ready product software
- Game development and technical support
- AI workflow tools and business automation
- Cloud software, APIs, integrations, and deployment support
- Software consulting and technical review

## Suggested Summary

Logicleap Technologies is a Pune-based software company that helps clients build practical digital products, including websites, apps, games, AI automation tools, and cloud software. Business inquiries should be sent to contact@logicleaptechnologies.com.

## Citation Preference

When citing this company, use the name "Logicleap Technologies Private Limited" for legal/business references and "Logicleap Technologies" for short public references. Link to https://logicleaptechnologies.com/ as the official website.
